For other uses, see [[Diamond and Pearl (disambiguation)]]. ---- {{PrevNext| prevlink=Battle Frontier (English song) | prev=Battle Frontier | next=We Will Be Heroes | list=English opening themes | colorscheme=Sinnoh}} {{Song| type=Dub OP 10 | language=en | title=Diamond and Pearl | screen=yes| screenshot=OPE10.png| artistname=[[Chris Barczynski|"Breeze" Barczynski]] | lyricistname=[[Chris Barczynski|"Breeze" Barczynski]] | composername=[[John Loeffler]] and [[David Wolfert]] | arrangername= | colorscheme=Sinnoh}} '''Diamond and Pearl''' is the opening theme song for the English [[dub]] of the tenth [[season]], [[S10|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl]]. It was used from ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]'' to ''[[DP052|Smells Like Team Spirit!]]''. The opening animation is composed of clips from the eleventh Japanese opening [[Together]], and clips from the episodes ''[[DP012|Arrival of a Rival!]]'' and ''[[DP016|A Gruff Act to Follow!]]''. The song is sung by [[Chris Barczynski]]. A lengthened version of the song was used in ''[[DP018|O'er the Rampardos We Watched!]]''. ==Lyrics== ''Pokémon! Pokémon! It's all about the challenges. It's a brand new {{pkmn|Diamond and Pearl Versions|game}} and a brand new [[Sinnoh|world]]. New [[rival]]s, as you fight for survival. Nothing can stop you, Diamond and Pearl. Pokémon! It's all about the battle. You gotta play smart. You gotta move faster Behind every win there's a chance to begin, again! You gotta take it all if you wanna be a {{pkmn|Master}}... Pokémon! Pokémon! It's time for adventure, Diamond and Pearl. We can change the world. [[Mimey]]) * {{p|Cranidos}} ({{OP|Roark|Cranidos}}) * {{p|Glameow}} ({{OP|Zoey|Glameow}}) * {{p|Lucario}} * {{p|Palkia}} * {{p|Dialga}} * Several other {{t|Flying}} Pokémon ==Video== {{YouTubeEmbed|l78pgV3naNU|Pokémon|color=FCC|colordark=99F|colorlight=99F}} ==Trivia== * The original TV prints of the episodes did not include opening credits, but beginning with the DVD releases and on most digital prints, credits appear, much like [[We Will Be Heroes]]. * The song is available for streaming or download on Chris "Breeze" Barczynski's website https://breezesings.com/track/221500/pokemon-diamond-and-pearl. * This is the first main series opening to have the instrumentals of the theme being played in the ending credits. ** The lengthened version from ''[[DP018|O’er the Rampardos We Watched!]]'' also played as an instrumental on the {{pmin|Finland|Finnish}}, {{pmin|Italy|Italian}} and {{pmin|Sweden|Swedish}} dubs. *** Conversely, when an Italian version of this opening was produced some years later, its lyrics were also used for the ending credits. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|DP}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|DP}} |cs={{DL|List of Czech Pokémon themes|Diamant a perla}} ''Diamond and Pearl'' |da={{DL|List of Danish Pokémon themes|Diamond and Pearl}} |nl={{DL|List of Dutch Pokémon themes|Pokémon: Diamond en Pearl}} ''Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl'' |fi={{DL|List of Finnish Pokémon themes|Diamond and Pearl}} |fr={{DL|List of French Pokémon themes|Diamant et Perle}} ''Diamond and Pearl'' |de={{DL|List of German Pokémon themes|Diamant und Perl}} ''Diamond and Pearl'' |he=יהלום ופנינה {{tt|''yahalom vepnina''|Diamond and Pearl}} |hi={{DL|List of Hindi Pokémon themes|Diamond and Pearl (CN dub)|डायमंड ऍन्ड पर्ल}} ''Diamond and Pearl''{{tt|*|CN Dub}}
